title: The Hallway Track: Would You Trust an Agent to Send Your Email?
description:
We asked AI Engineer SF attendees the question that always gets people talking: would you trust an agent to send an email on your behalf, sight unseen? The answers get into observability, hallucination risk, and where the "non-reversible" line really is once an agent's output starts reaching people outside your own org.

Part of The Hallway Track — real conversations, caught between sessions, at AI Engineer SF.
